name: SERNKOU
recent: Sern Kou 于2026年11月20日召开第26届年度股东大会，所有决议均获通过。公司于9月底宣布将逐步关闭亏损的胶合板制造业务。此外，董事经理 Low Peng Sian 在11月中旬于闭门期内减持股份。
notable: 第26届年度股东大会于2026年11月20日举行，所有普通决议均获通过。
公司宣布将逐步关闭亏损的胶合板制造业务。
Kenanga 旗下伊斯兰基金于2026年9月成为持股11.17%的大股东。
risks: 董事经理 Low Peng Sian 于2026年11月16日及19日在闭门期内合计减持约2,100万股。
公司2026财年全年净亏损1,589万令吉，净利率为-14.3%，亏损较上期扩大。
earnings: 2026财年（截至6月30日）营收为1.115亿令吉，同比下降25.0%，环比增长16.3%；净亏损1,589万令吉，净利率为-14.3%，较上期的-5.6%扩大。

recent_en: Sern Kou held its 26th AGM on 20 November 2026, with all resolutions passed. The company announced in late September that it would wind down its loss-making plywood manufacturing unit. Separately, Managing Director Low Peng Sian disposed of shares during the closed period in mid-November.
notable_en: The 26th AGM was held on 20 November 2026 and all ordinary resolutions were passed.
The company announced it will wind down its loss-making plywood manufacturing operations.
Kenanga's Islamic fund emerged as a substantial shareholder with an 11.17% stake in September 2026.
risks_en: Managing Director Low Peng Sian disposed of approximately 21 million shares in total on 16 and 19 November 2026 during the closed period.
The company recorded a full-year net loss of MYR 15.89 million for FY2026, with a net margin of -14.3%, widening from the previous period.
earnings_en: FY2026 (ended 30 June) revenue was MYR 111.5 million, down 25.0% YoY but up 16.3% QoQ; net loss was MYR 15.89 million with a net margin of -14.3%, widening from -5.6% in the prior period.
